title: TDD: FlintTextRenderer with golden tests matching Compose SDK
description: TDD. Write failing tests first. Port of FlintTextRenderer.kt. Tests: renders screen name, renders content elements, renders list with items, item content joined with pipe separator, renders overlays with content and actions, renders tool names, handles empty snapshot, handles no tools. Golden tests: hardcoded snapshot inputs verified against exact Compose SDK output strings. Output must be byte-identical.
